summary: Produced the backend design artefact for OBS-05 dead letter queue at src/design/obs-05-dead-letter-queue.md. The design defines end-to-end DLQ architecture and API contract for exhausted-retry SERVICE_TASK/webhook/timer processing, full-context DLQ schema, deterministic GET /dlq pagination and filtering, POST retry/discard semantics with idempotency and transaction guarantees, CANCELLED-instance 409 conflict plus discard behavior, mandatory OBS-03 audit append on discard, security and failure semantics, and full requirement-to-design traceability mapped to implementation and test hooks.

tests_run.name: design completeness and traceability review
tests_run.detail: Validated all OBS-05 acceptance criteria and edge cases against explicit design sections, route contracts, DLQ lifecycle semantics, and traceability rows with module and test obligations.
